description: This file defines the ArtifactInfoContext class, which manages collections of entity names, service names, and visited simple methods within an artifact processing context in the Apache OFBiz minilang framework.

classes.name: ArtifactInfoContext
classes.description: A utility class for gathering and managing information about entities, services, and methods encountered during artifact processing.

methods.name: addEntityName
methods.description: Adds a new entity name to the context's entity set if the name is not null.

methods.name: addServiceName
methods.description: Adds a new service name to the context's service set if the name is not null.

methods.name: addSimpleMethod
methods.description: Records a visited SimpleMethod in the context by its location and name.

methods.name: getEntityNames
methods.description: Returns the set of entity names collected in this context.

methods.name: getServiceNames
methods.description: Returns the set of service names collected in this context.

methods.name: hasVisited
methods.description: Checks if a given SimpleMethod has already been visited in this context.
